drought: June-August station rain < 50% of the 1991-2020 mean (116 mm)
excess_moisture: June-August station rain > 150% of that mean (rain at haying)
heat: a day with station Tmax >= 38 C (35 C is reached in most summers on the valley floor)
grouping.other: frost: a day with station Tmin <= -1 C between 10 May and 15 Sep (frost after green-up)

share_drought.note: Estimate (U): 5 of 15 peril-years; June-August station rain < 50% of the 1991-2020 mean (116 mm). BC Production Insurance loss data is not public at field or county level, and USDA RMA covers the United States only. Each year with a peril counts once per peril; the peril rules are assumptions (U).
